arguments.value: Ubuntu 20.04 user reports a Blue Yeti microphone no longer offers duplex in pavucontrol, so it can’t be selected as both input and output at the same time. The Yeti now only shows analog/digital input or output profiles, unlike screenshots showing a Digital Stereo Duplex option, and the user asks what changed and whether a driver/update is needed.
